categories.en: A report can have several categories. Period counts use the displayed number of selected reports as their denominator.
categories.ha: Rahoto na iya shiga rukuni fiye da ɗaya. Lissafin kowane lokaci ya dogara da adadin rahotannin da aka zaɓa da aka nuna.

connections.en: An article connection means two names appear in the same report. Recorded cooperation and agreements have separate evidence and qualifications.
connections.ha: Alaƙar labari tana nufin sunaye biyu sun bayyana a rahoto ɗaya. Haɗin gwiwa da yarjejeniyoyin da aka ruwaito suna da nasu hujjoji da sharudda.

dates.en: The timeline uses publication dates unless a verified event date is recorded.
dates.ha: Jadawalin lokaci yana amfani da ranar wallafa rahoto sai idan an rubuta ranar taron da aka tabbatar.

figures.en: Delivery figures are attributed reports. Targets remain plans. Overlapping groups cannot be added into a reliable total of unique people.
figures.ha: Lambobin tallafin da aka bayar suna dogara da rahotannin da aka ambata. Manufofin cimmawa tsare-tsare ne. Ba za a haɗa ƙungiyoyin da ka iya maimaita mutane domin samun tabbatacciyar jimillar mutane ba.

language.en: The topic model analysed English articles. Hausa labels and explanations are draft translations awaiting human review.

scope.en: This dataset covers selected, checked reports. It is not a complete record of lifetime work.
scope.ha: Wannan kundin ya ƙunshi zaɓaɓɓun rahotannin da aka bincika. Ba cikakken tarihin dukkan ayyukan rayuwa ba ne.

topics.en: Themes describe patterns in published words. Filters select from one saved model; they do not retrain it.
topics.ha: Jigogi suna bayyana tsarin kalmomin da aka wallafa. Matatun bincike suna zaɓa daga samfurin da aka adana; ba sa sake koyar da shi.

method.activity_stage_method: Activity stage describes its reporting context. observation_ids and observation_stages enumerate linked measures; delivery and target observations can coexist in one activity and retain their own units, populations and bounds.
method.entity_method: Reviewed alias dictionary; case-insensitive whole-token matching after punctuation/whitespace normalization. Short name-shaped standalone author bylines and By Our Correspondent / By Reporter are excluded; narrative paragraphs starting By and in-body mentions are retained.

model.category_policy: Reviewed multi-label source coverage; category shares need not sum to 100%
model.language: English-source text; Hausa labels/explanations are drafts, not Hausa-corpus analysis
model.method: Eight-topic NMF over TF-IDF word/phrase features
model.representative_review: Selected texts source-context checked; see label_review_complete for term/representative interpretation status
model.scope: Reviewed selected-source preview: 31 source records / 30 distinct texts, not the full archive or a representative career sample. Owner accepted Phase 1 checkpoint to advance; full numerical review remains incomplete. English-source NLP; Hausa explanations are drafts.
model.zero_vector_policy: Period topic means exclude zero-vector documents; denominators and modelled counts are explicit

method.model_documents: Exact full-text duplicates collapsed; earliest publication, then lowest archive ID.
method.network_method: Co-occurrence in canonical articles; partnerships require separate reviewed exact excerpts.
method.period_method: Unique canonical posts by publication year; category denominator includes all posts; topic means exclude zero vectors.
method.population_reconciliation: Exact observation dimensions/population; two explicitly reviewed starter cohort aliases retained as descriptions.
method.sample_limitation: A selected source-context-checked sample; not the full archive, a representative career distribution or independent impact evaluation.
method.topic_method: English-source TF-IDF / eight-topic NMF; exploratory descriptive themes.
